reasoning: The icon clearly depicts a three-panel folded map paired with a magnifying glass, universally understood as searching a map or looking up a location. It fits real-world tasks around scouting neighborhoods, locating venues, checking routes, and exploring areas before travel, while remaining distinct from a plain map or a standalone search icon.
